description: This file contains a series of test scripts for verifying shallow and non-shallow cloning behavior of git repositories with submodules, including setup, execution, and assertions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after a test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message and changes.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in the log output.

methods.name: git submodule add
methods.description: Adds a submodule to the repository.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
